name: economyUtils
author: Takaro
description: A set of commands to allow players to manage their currency.

pendingAmount.title: Pending amount
pendingAmount.description: When a player transfers money, they must confirm the transfer when the amount is equal or above this value. Set to 0 to disable.

zombieKillReward.title: Zombie kill reward
zombieKillReward.description: The default amount of currency a player receives for killing a zombie. This can be overridden by roles.

permissions.description: Allows players to manage currency of other players. This includes granting and revoking currency.
Allows a role to override the amount of currency a player receives for killing a entity.

topCurrency.helpText: List of the 10 players with the highest balance.

grantCurrency.helpText: Grant money to a player. The money is not taken from your own balance but is new currency.

arguments.name: receiver
arguments.helpText: The player to grant currency to.

revokeCurrency.helpText: Revokes money from a player. The money disappears.

arguments.name: receiver
arguments.helpText: The player to revoke currency from.

arguments.name: receiver
arguments.helpText: The player to transfer money to.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.helpText: The amount of money to transfer.

arguments.name: all
arguments.helpText: If true, claim ALL pending orders. If false, claim only the first one.

shop.helpText: Browse the shop and view available items.

arguments.name: page
arguments.helpText: Display more items from the shop by specifying a page number.

arguments.name: item
arguments.helpText: Select a specific item to view more details.

arguments.name: action
arguments.helpText: Perform an action on the selected item. Currently only "buy" is supported.
